column1: # BabelSoft Script Data: Miyake Tangut Phonetic Reconstruction
#   Miyake phonetic reconstruction data for Tangut characters. Each entry
#   maps a Tangut codepoint to its syllable (initial-medial-final-tone
#   indices) and rime group. The actual phonetic values are in
#   1. codepoint   - Unicode codepoint in U+XXXXX format
